parameters.query: select j.jobname, r.status, coalesce(r.return_message, '') as return_message, r.start_time, coalesce(nullif((select value from app_config where key='ops_alert_email'),''), 'honlamchia@gmail.com') as ops_email from cron.job_run_details r join cron.job j on j.jobid = r.jobid where r.status = 'failed' and r.start_time >= now() - interval '24 hours' order by r.start_time desc

insert into pipeline_errors (occurred_at, company, phase, node_name, error_msg, resolved) select $1::timestamptz, 'pg_cron', 'pg-cron', $2, $3, false where not exists (select 1 from pipeline_errors where phase = 'pg-cron' and node_name = $2 and occurred_at = $1::timestamptz) returning id
